Module app
Package app.model

Class Plant

java.lang.Object
app.model.Plant
public class Plant extends Object
Plant is a custom type that contains all of the details of a plant.

  • Constructor Details

    • Plant

      public Plant(String generalisedInfo, String growthInfo, String images, String stateProvince, String scientificName, String kingdom, String phylum, String pclass, String order, String family, String genus, String taxonRank, String vernacularName, String species, String edible, String hazardous, String subspecies)
      Constructs a new Plant object with the specified details.
      Parameters:
      generalisedInfo - The general information about the plant
      growthInfo - The growth information of the plant
      images - The image URLs of the plant
      stateProvince - The state or province where the plant is found
      scientificName - The scientific name of the plant
      kingdom - The kingdom classification of the plant
      phylum - The phylum classification of the plant
      pclass - The class classification of the plant
      order - The order classification of the plant
      family - The family classification of the plant
      genus - The genus classification of the plant
      taxonRank - The taxonomic rank of the plant
      vernacularName - The common name of the plant
      species - The species classification of the plant
      edible - Indicates if the plant is edible
      hazardous - Indicates if the plant is hazardous
      subspecies - The subspecies classification of the plant
